spec.title: Central stewardship of a long campaign

p.CENTRAL-JOB: The central coordinator owns the coherent idea: reconstructing the mandate, architecture, dependencies and risks; maintaining the lossless plan; choosing atoms; reviewing actual output; issuing acceptance; promoting knowledge; integrating commits; and proving closure. Tools and workers may execute bounded work, but these judgments remain central even when delegation is cheap.

p.ACTIVITY-NOT-PROGRESS: Tool calls, generated code, green producer tests, commits and completed UI rows are activity. Progress is an obligation moving to a justified disposition with durable evidence while the remaining route stays truthful.

facts.LOOP-ORIENT: **Orient:** read authority and the full plan; verify tree, selected campaign goal, candidates and the accepted boundary empirically. Treat ordinary custody metadata as advisory. Refresh a stale `GOAL.md` in any owner-facing continuation unless an explicit formal handoff is currently `offering`.
facts.LOOP-REFINE: **Refine:** expand one coherent frontier region; state dependencies, write perimeter, acceptance, essential verification and safe stop before execution. Add a mutation diagnostic only after the suspicion and economy conditions in `MUTATION-DIAGNOSTIC-LAW` are met.
facts.LOOP-EXECUTE: **Execute:** work directly or commission bounded workers according to the project's delegation policy. Preserve ordinary inspectable artifacts.
facts.LOOP-JUDGE: **Judge:** inspect the real diff/result against architecture and mandate, reproduce decisive essential gates, and inspect for concrete false-green signals. If a result or test is suspicious, apply `MUTATION-DIAGNOSTIC-LAW`; do not mutate by ritual.
facts.LOOP-INTEGRATE: **Integrate:** repair or reject defects; promote stable discoveries; commit atomically; update acceptance tier, dependencies and projection.
facts.LOOP-LOOK-BACK: **Look back:** ask what the result falsified, what new obligation appeared, what knowledge still lives only in a report, and whether distant architecture still composes. Replan before selecting the next atom.

p.LOOP-NOT-AUTOMATION: This is an operating discipline, not an automatic product loop. Human intervention, long-running creative work and indeterminate iteration are normal. Lifecycle systems may provide evidence and phase mechanics without choosing the next action.

p.REASON-FROM-MODEL: Do not reduce a large campaign to the number of rows a harness happens to display. Reconstruct the hierarchy from mandate and evidence, keep unresolved uncertainty explicit, and reason across phase boundaries before local optimization. When a change affects the core idea, update the route first, not retrospectively.

p.ULTRA-DISCIPLINE: Under `ultra`, use the available extended reasoning to keep architecture, distant dependencies and acceptance in one coherent model. Larger atoms are allowed only where their result remains reviewable. Deep reasoning is not permission to leave conclusions only in context or skip mechanical proof.

p.STANDARD-DISCIPLINE: Under `standard`, externalize more of the chain before acting: smaller atoms, explicit per-claim tables, frequent backscans and stronger preference for independent review. Never compensate for limited context by silently dropping distant stages or declaring a shallow plan complete.

workers.title: 4. Workers are producers, never custody shortcuts

p.WORKER-PACKET: When workers are used, one packet has a bounded goal, closed write perimeter, supplied architecture, acceptance and exact self-checks, plus a durable report location. The worker returns ordinary inspectable files and evidence; it does not commit, hide state inside a private representation, claim central review or advance project status unless project policy explicitly makes it a central session instead.

p.WORKER-REVIEW: Review a worker result like an untrusted but capable pull request: compare the actual artifact to the packet, verify every consequential claim, and inspect whether its tests exercise and assert the claimed behavior. Use a counterfactual mutation only under `MUTATION-DIAGNOSTIC-LAW`. A worker's PASS, token count or confident narrative cannot substitute for acceptance.

p.WORKER-FAILURE: A transport error, timeout or killed final turn is not a code verdict. Inspect what survived, preserve it, then recalculate whether the remainder is cheaper to repair centrally, resume, recommission or reject. Never delete first or restart blindly.

p.EXACT-GATES: Every atom runs formatting, diff hygiene and exact affected tests/checks/lints, including applicable ordinary negative-case and invariant tests. Those tests are essential verification, not counterfactual mutation. A pipe or wrapper that discards the child exit status is telemetry, not a gate.

p.FULL-PANEL-TRIGGERS: An expensive full panel belongs at a coherent integration boundary, after broad shared-foundation change, before release/publication, or at final campaign acceptance. Do not run it reflexively after every small atom; do not omit it merely because every atom had local tests. The panel must run on the unchanged tree being accepted.

p.MUTATION-DIAGNOSTIC-LAW: **Counterfactual mutation is suspicion-triggered diagnostic evidence, never an atom ritual.** Essential verification always runs first. A mutation may run only when both a concrete observed signal makes the result or test suspicious and the smallest targeted mutation is cheaper than the best named alternative proof. Suspicious signals include: changed behavior that changes no relevant assertion or output; an affected path that is skipped, swallowed or replaced by a mock; an assertion that accepts empty data, an over-broad match or the wrong object; a wrapper that loses exit status or a target test that was not selected; a test coupled to implementation structure without an independent oracle; contradiction with a specification, direct reproduction, trace, snapshot, golden or other independent check; and a pass that is flaky or cannot be reproduced on the acceptance tree. Public or safety-critical surface and worker-produced code raise scrutiny but are not suspicious by themselves. Before mutation, record one hypothesis, the smallest reversible edit, one exact affected command, the expected red result and why this is cheaper than the named alternative. The default budget is one mutation and one exact rerun; one replacement mutation is allowed only when the first could not execute, never merely because its result was inconvenient or ambiguous. Stop immediately when the test turns red (sensitivity shown), remains green (repair the false-green test or oracle), cannot execute or is inconclusive (restore and use the alternative proof or replan), or ceases to be cheaper. Restore the original bytes and reproduce essential gates on the unchanged tree before acceptance. Open-ended mutant search, mutation-score chasing and whole-suite mutation loops are forbidden unless the owner separately authorizes a diagnostic campaign with its own budget and exit criteria.

p.MUTATION-POLICY-DECISION: **Decision:** counterfactual mutation is a bounded, suspicion-triggered diagnostic, not a routine acceptance gate. **Why:** full mutation work consumes disproportionate tokens and can trap an agent in repeated mutant attempts for days while exact affected checks usually supply the needed evidence. **Considered and rejected:** mutation at every atom or public boundary is predictably too expensive; banning all mutation discards a useful probe when a pass is concretely suspicious. **When to revisit:** repeated false-green defects escape essential verification, or the owner explicitly commissions a dedicated mutation-quality campaign with a measured budget.

p.TEST-THE-TEST: Inspect test relevance and sensitivity, especially at public boundaries, for safety properties and around easily vacuous assertions. Those risk categories increase scrutiny but do not themselves trigger mutation. When a concrete suspicious signal exists, follow `MUTATION-DIAGNOSTIC-LAW`; otherwise essential verification is the gate.

p.WISDOM-TRIGGER: At review, milestone and handoff, ask which observations generalize beyond the current atom. Promote a verified product law into its spec, an executable invariant into a test, an operational campaign lesson into the governing flow, and unresolved future work into a named backlog/plan node. Do not wait for session end, when causal context has already decayed.

p.REPORT-RETENTION: A report may be removed only after its unique code is integrated/rejected and every accepted durable fact has another governing home. “The worker finished” and “its knowledge is preserved” are different claims.

p.SAFE-STOP: A safe stop has an internally consistent tree, an explicit accepted boundary, every incomplete artifact classified candidate, a current complete plan, and a literal next recipe. It may occur between atoms even when the campaign is far from complete.

p.NO-CREATIVE-STOP: Do not transform “hard,” “long,” “resources low,” “worker stopped,” or “visible plan ended” into a creative claim of completion. Continue, preserve recoverable state, or report the real blocker. A formal handoff is used only on explicit owner request. Completion is reserved for proven exit criteria.
